description: Look up one of your own receipts by receipt_id: returns the stored signed receipt, its signature check, and settlement state. Free. The wallet must be the one that paid. One receipt by id: this tool. Your whole history: receipt_history. A check on a URL: check_url_custom.

agent_wallet.description: Your wallet address — the one that paid. Results are scoped to this account.

receipt_id.description: Receipt id, emb_ followed by 24 hex characters

name: receipt_lookup

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the receipt was issued, or null

found.description: True when the receipt exists and belongs to the wallet

receipt_id.description: The receipt id, or null when not found

receipt_json.description: The full stored receipt as a JSON string (public view, PII redacted), or null

settlement_state.description: Reconciled settlement state of the payment, or null

signature_valid.description: True when the receipt's signature verifies against the published signer

tool.description: Tool that issued the receipt, or null

title: Receipt — Lookup
